knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dust on a listed fitting is part of the standard. A made bed and vacuumed floor do not complete the room.
A written standard applied the same way lets two cleaners produce the same result.
Looks, touch and smell are separate parts of the standard and each is checked.

practicalCriteria: Given a written room standard, names the seen, touched, smelt and found parts that apply to a simulated room.
Walks a simulated room from the doorway and identifies at least two faults that a quick look would miss.
Records the standard applied on the job checklist before reporting the room as ready.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 percent pass mark (all three correct). Practical criteria are observed and signed off separately by an assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Completed job checklist for the simulated room
stopWorkCriteria: Room reported as ready while a listed fault remains
Air freshener used to cover an odour without finding its source
